subject: FinTrust enterprise access kickoff — SSO, SCIM, service accounts
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Pam Liu <pam.liu@fintrust.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrust - Enterprise access: SSO, SCIM, service accounts (kickoff)

Hi Pam —

Thanks for taking this on with your infra team. Quick note to align on scope and a proposed plan so we can lock a staging window. Goal: get SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning in place, plus an API service account and IP allowlist for production traffic.

Proposed mutual action plan (first pass):
- Exchange SAML metadata (FinTrust) and confirm assertion attributes (email, groups) — owner: FinTrust (ASAP)
- SCIM: map groups -> roles and restrict to prod-redwood group(s); Redwood to provide a SCIM mapping template — owner: Redwood (deliverables attached)
- IP allowlist: provide list of egress IPs for Redwood staging and prod; FinTrust to whitelist — owner: mutual
- Service account: create scoped API service account (short-lived tokens recommended) and provide key provisioning steps — owner: Redwood
- Org policy enforcement: define which groups get admin vs user roles; any RBAC tags needed for your policies — owner: joint
- Security questionnaire / evidence (SOC2, logs) — we can attach the standard package on request — owner: Redwood

Attachments: scim-mapping-template.csv, ip-allowlist-template.csv (see attached).

Can you share your IdP metadata (Okta/ADFS/Azure AD) and confirm whether you prefer SAML or OIDC? Also please confirm an initial staging window: we typically run a 90–120 minute connectivity + provisioning test. I can propose Thu 23 Jul 10:00–12:00 PDT if that works.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our CS lead (Marissa) to manage the mutual action plan and our identity engineer (Neha) for technical details.

—
Sean Gallagher
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Pam Liu <pam.liu@fintrust.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@fintrust.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust - Enterprise access: SSO, SCIM, service accounts (kickoff)

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear plan.

A few quick answers:
- We use Okta as our IdP and prefer SAML for now (we have legacy SAML apps; OIDC is on our road map). I’m attaching our Okta XML metadata (FinTrust_OKTA_Metadata.xml).
- For SCIM, we want provisioning scoped to a single AD group ("redwood-access-prod") — we do not want to sync our entire directory. Can Redwood support group-scoped provisioning and delta syncs?
- For service accounts, security policy wants keys rotated every 30 days. Can Redwood support short-lived tokens or an automated rotation flow?
- IP allowlisting: I’ll pull our egress whitelist team and send a contact.

Proposed people here for the technical session: Alex Mercer (infra lead) and myself. Alex handles Okta and SCIM.

Availability: Thu 23 Jul 10:00–12:00 PDT works tentatively for us — I’ll confirm with Alex and the network team by EOD Monday.

Attached: FinTrust_OKTA_Metadata.xml

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Pam Liu <pam.liu@fintrust.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@fintrust.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust - Enterprise access: SSO, SCIM, service accounts (kickoff)

Pam — thanks for the fast reply and for the Okta metadata. A few clarifications and commitments from our side:

1) SAML vs OIDC
- Redwood supports both SAML and OIDC. Given your environment and preference for Okta/SAML, we’ll validate SAML assertions for email and groups. We also support OIDC if you want to migrate later.

2) SCIM scoping and delta syncs
- Yes — we support group-scoped provisioning. Best practice: create a dedicated group (redwood-access-prod) that you control. Redwood will only provision users in that group and perform delta syncs every 5 minutes during staging (configurable). Attached is the SCIM mapping template you can pre-fill: scim-mapping-template.csv.

3) Service accounts and rotation
- We strongly recommend short-lived tokens. Redwood can either: (a) issue bearer tokens that rotate every 14 days via an automated rotation webhook, or (b) accept rotating machine credentials from your secret manager (Vault/Azure Key Vault). Let us know preference; we can configure the default to 30 days to match your policy.

4) IP allowlist and prod staging
- Our staging egress IPs: 34.199.12.45, 34.199.12.46. Production ranges will be provided before go-live. Please use the ip-allowlist-template.csv (attached) to record the CIDR ranges you will whitelist.

5) Timeline
- Proposed staging window: Thu 23 Jul 10:00–12:00 PDT — we will run connectivity, SAML assertion validation, group-provisioning test, and a short end-to-end read/write test using a test service account. Can Alex confirm by Mon EOD?

6) Deliverables
- I’m attaching a generated SAML metadata file for Redwood to simplify your IdP setup (FinTrust_SAML_Metadata.xml). I’m also linking the mutual action plan in HubSpot: https://redwood.app/hubspot/FT-3421

If that looks good I’ll mark the staging window and Marissa will follow up with the formal mutual action plan (owners, dates, success criteria).

—
Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Pam Liu <pam.liu@fintrust.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@fintrust.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust - Enterprise access: SSO, SCIM, service accounts (kickoff)

Hi Pam / Alex —

Thanks — confirming we’re on track to run the staging session on Thu 23 Jul 10:00–12:00 PDT pending your signoff. Below is the initial mutual action plan with owners and success criteria. I’ve attached an editable M.A.P. (mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Exchange metadata and configure IdP (FinTrust) — success: SAML assertion validated (email + groups) — owner: FinTrust (Pam / Alex) — due: 22 Jul EOD
2) Configure SCIM mapping in staging (Redwood) — success: provisioning of 3 test users into redwood-access-prod — owner: Redwood (Neha) — due: 23 Jul during staging
3) Create API service account (Redwood) — success: we can authenticate with rotating token and call read/write endpoints — owner: Redwood (Marissa) — due: 23 Jul staging
4) IP allowlist confirmation (FinTrust) — success: staging egress IPs accepted by FinTrust firewall — owner: FinTrust (network team) — due: 22 Jul EOD
5) Org policy mapping and RBAC review (joint) — success: role assignments verified in console (admin/user) — owner: Laura + FinTrust secops — due: 24 Jul EOD

Service account details we will create (proposed):
- Name: fintrust-redwood-svc
- Scopes: embeddings:read, inference:invoke (no admin privileges)
- Token rotation: API token TTL 14 days (can set to 30d to match your policy)

Notes / risks:
- If FinTrust requires HSM-backed keys for the service account, raise now so we can scope additional work.
- If OIDC migration occurs mid-onboarding, we will coordinate OIDC client registration separately.

Please reply to this thread with a one-line sign-off ("confirm staging" or "need to reschedule") and any additional attendees for the staging window. Once Pam or Alex confirm, I will create the calendar invite with dial-in and pre-run checklist.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (editable), referenced earlier: scim-mapping-template.csv, ip-allowlist-template.csv

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (628) 555-0109
